overview: Ka Vethan is the Akhevan capital-city, seat of Praesertum authority, and the oldest surviving arcane metropolis on Luclin.
history: Founded by the earliest Akhevan lineages after the Luclinite schism.
Constructed around a resonance core that stabilizes Akhevan ritual magic.
Expanded through eras of Praesertum governance and arcane refinement.
Served as the command center during multiple Luclinite conflicts.
Modern Ka Vethan remains the political, ritual, and military heart of Akhevan civilization.
campaignHooks: Investigate Praesertum decrees affecting Luclin’s balance.
Uncover forbidden archives within the Echo Archives.
Navigate political tensions between Akhevan factions.
Stabilize resonance anomalies emerging from the Grand Core.
